characterizations.result_summary: Number-average molecular weights and polydispersity indices for polymers 8a, 8b, 9a, 9b, 10, 11, 12 were measured.
Number-average molecular weight of perylene bisimide-labeled polystyrene after 3h polymerization was measured as 17800 g·mol⁻¹.
Glass transition temperatures for polymers 8a, 8b, 9a, 9b, 10, 11 were measured.
5% weight loss thermal decomposition temperatures for polymers 8a, 8b, 9a, 9b, 10, 11, 12 were measured.
¹H NMR spectra were recorded for polymers 8a, 8b, 9a, 9b, 10, 11, 12.
IR spectra were recorded for polymers 8b, 9b, 10, 11, 12.
Order parameter (OP) values for polymers 8a and 8b were measured from UV-vis absorption spectra in films.
